items.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg tells employees he does not expect more company-wide layoffs this year
items.description: The changes are part of a far-reaching overhaul taking place at Meta this year, as the company surges its AI investments in a bid to center AI agents in both its product offerings and its approach to work internally.

items.title: ChatGPT maker OpenAI preparing to file for IPO in coming days or weeks: Report
items.description: The report said the ChatGPT maker is working with bankers at Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley on a draft IPO prospectus that it plans to file confidentially with regulators soon, possibly as early as Friday.

items.title: Energy costs have hit us hard, says Jubilant FoodWorks CEO

items.title: Stellantis, JLR sign MoU to explore product development collaboration in US

items.title: Domino's India operator Jubilant FoodWorks reports 66% rise in Q4 net profit
items.description: During the year, the operator added a net 351 stores across brands and geographies, ending FY26 with a global network of 3,636 stores. Of these, 289 net stores were added in India

items.title: Tata Steel’s UK plant wins exemption from US steel tariff rules
items.description: The UK has been granted a reduced 25% levy, but imports are generally subject to strict “melt-and-pour” rules requiring the product to be produced entirely within Britain

items.title: MakeMyTrip records $10.4 billion gross bookings for FY26
items.description: Group Chief Executive Officer Magow said that the company's FY26 performance was led by bus ticketing that grew at over 29%.

items.title: Zee Entertainment reports loss of Rs 104 crore in Q4 FY26 amid pressure in ad revenue
items.description: Ad revenue in the March quarter of FY26 dropped 3.7% due to Middle East crisis.

items.title: Standard Chartered to cut 7,000 jobs as AI replaces 'lower-value human capital'
items.description: Standard Chartered plans to eliminate more than 7,000 jobs over four years as it increases AI adoption and automation to improve profitability and streamline operations.

items.title: OPINION | Why leaders must protect goodness around them
items.description: Leadership is not only about personal integrity. It is also about protecting honest people from pressure, fear and compromise so goodness can survive within institutions

items.title: Production data shows Honda ahead of Hero in Jan-Apr two-wheeler volumes
items.description: Between January and April, Honda Motorcycle overtook Hero MotoCorp in two-wheeler production volumes, rolling out 2.26 million units from its four manufacturing plants. Hero produced 2.18 million units across six factories during the same period.

items.title: Google, Blackstone to create new AI cloud company: Report
items.description: Blackstone is expected to contribute $5 billion in equity and hold a majority stake in the unnamed U.S. venture, the report said.

items.title: Standard Chartered to cut over 15% support roles amid AI push

items.title: China will open its market to AI chips from US: Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang
